epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Docker Compose boot failures due to MinIO image pull errors from 100% to 0%
epics.tocConstraintRef: Local environment Docker Compose boot process
requirements: R1: Update the MinIO image tag in the Docker Compose configuration to a resolvable and valid version.

slices.title: Update MinIO Docker image tag
slices.jtbd: When implementing the MinIO tag fix for this epic, I want to patch the docker-compose configuration with a valid image tag, so that all confirmed falsification findings are resolved and the infrastructure starts successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a Docker Compose configuration with an invalid MinIO image tag,
When the image tag is updated to a resolvable version,
Then executing the Docker Compose boot command should successfully pull the image and start the container without errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease MinIO image resolution error count from 1 to 0
